representative_scale.selection: All published PINDER-S cases with both apo partners. Freeze IDs and custom index before run.
representative_scale.candidate_count_basis: Fixed intake protocol matching published top-5 scoring, not asserted historical docking configuration.
representative_scale.secondary_aav: Separate optional challenge; not pooled into primary 93-case score.

inputs.experimental: Native dimer and paired unbound receptor/ligand for each selected case, from PINDER 2024-02.
inputs.generated: Five ranked predicted complexes per case: eval_dir/<method>/<pinder_id>/apo_decoys/model_<rank>.pdb; chains R and L.
inputs.manifest: Pinned case manifest/custom index preserving PINDER schema.
inputs.seed_schedule_reason: Independent seeds required by brief; no published seed values established.

outputs.primary_reporting: Rank-1 DockQ and maximum DockQ among exactly five generated candidates; report fractions of selected cases with DockQ >=0.23 for each. Report per-case metrics and seed repeats separately.
performance: time to first acceptable pose or censored failure
outputs.runtime_target_reason: No independently verified published runtime, throughput or cost anchor.

timing_scope.search: Start after selected experimental inputs are available and normalized; include per-case maps/features, candidate search, ranking and pose writing.
timing_scope.evaluation: Measure scoring separately against native complexes; native structures must not influence search or ranking.
timing_scope.setup: Record installation and download time separately.
timing_scope.time_to_acceptable: Requires candidate production timestamps and retrospective native scoring; unavailable from final ranked PDBs alone.
timing_scope.source: Brief requirements; timing boundaries are intake protocol choices, not published runtime claims.

budget_basis: Use supplied pipeline defaults: setup/anchors/profile/method_setup/method_run=1200, tests=900, evaluate=2400 seconds. No runtime measurements support a full docking completion guarantee; fail clearly within budget if unresolved requirements persist.

execution_readiness.full_docking: unavailable pending working optimized implementation and external software provenance
execution_readiness.memory_reason: Not published in inspected evidence and no workloads run.
execution_readiness.runtime_reason: No builds or workloads authorized during intake.
